translations.web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
translations.bsb: Does the rain have a father? Who has begotten the drops of dew?
translations.kjv: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
translations.asv: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
